text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara's racing outfit arrived.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Mine arrived too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe, I always thought running in a race wearing a racing outfit looked super cool!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look, look!! Amazing, right!?
Cool, right!? Looks tough, right!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know!
I'm gonna go show everyone!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, everyone, look, look!
My racing uniform has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She rushed out before I could stop her.
I held back from scolding her so as not to hurt her motivation, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer!
Can I wear this for training today? Pretty please?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer!
Can I wear it for a little bit during lunch break!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!
Can I sleep in my racing outfit tonight?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! But when I wear that,
I feel a hundred times stronger than usual, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So, I bet... I'll sleep like a log!
choice_data_list: You really liked it, didn't you...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "...This design, you see, was modeled after the gym uniform from the very first time I ever ran in a race."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I didn't win at all, but you know,
both Papa and Mama praised me a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: That's why wearing these clothes makes me feel so strong!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wear lots of layers, get lots stronger...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And then, I'll win in this outfit
and make everyone so, sooo happy!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So please, Trainer...!
choice_data_list: Tell her that "it'd be terrible if your precious clothes got torn."
Let them wear it to their heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?! It's gonna rip?! No waay!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I see. If it might tear,
we'll just have to treat it with extra care.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if I win, I get to wear it, so it's fine!
All right, I want to wear it again... so I'll do my best!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to slipping my arms through the sleeves,
I threw myself into training.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Really!? YAAAAAY!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely gonna do my super-duper best
so I can wear it for the real race soon!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thanks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Eventually, once she was satisfied, she offered on her own to hold onto it, saying, "I'll take good care of it until the big day!"
